scripts.screen:
// GET /screen  the waiting-room TV: now serving per service, updated live.
function handle(req) { return {template: 'screen', data: {title: clinic().name, clinic: clinic(), services: boards(), screen: true}}; }
scripts.state:
// GET /api/state  the boards as JSON.
function handle(req) { return {json: {day: today(), services: boards()}}; }
scripts.mcp_queue:
// MCP tool: the queue right now, for assistants.
function handle(req) { return {json: {clinic: clinic().name, day: today(), services: boards(), take_a_number: req.origin + '/'}}; }
